home.heroTitle: The Korea beyond Seoul is fifteen quiet counties wide.
home.heroSubtitle: Hub-and-spoke day trips and overnight courses built from real local data — temples, markets, mountains no guidebook covers.
home.whereTitle: Gyeongsangbuk-do sits inland, east of Daegu.
home.whereBody: Korea's largest province by area, wrapping the country's southeastern coast and mountainous interior. Most visitors pass through on the KTX without stopping — this app is built around four transit hubs you can actually reach.
home.whyTitle: Officially declining. Still worth the detour.
home.whyBody: The Korean government designates counties losing population fastest as "population-declining regions." All 15 in Gyeongsangbuk-do are here — not because they're empty, but because they're where local life hasn't been rebuilt for tourists yet.
home.sourcedFrom: Sourced from public tourism open data

about.title: About
about.why1: Beyond the well-known sights, Gyeongsangbuk-do holds far more places that only locals reach. The information is scattered and hard to act on, so their value stays unknown.
about.why2: Hidden Gyeongbuk gathers those places and connects them into courses you can actually travel, matched to your dates and interests.
about.why3: Accurate information and plain recommendations over loud marketing, so you can take Gyeongbuk slowly.
about.value1Desc: Down to the Korean address you can show a taxi driver. Can you actually get there — that is the test.
about.value2Desc: Machine translation is labelled as such. We do not hide where text came from.
about.value3Desc: One or two places seen properly beats a packed itinerary.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.sub: Send questions or suggestions by email. We reply within 2–3 business days.
contact.a1: Where no official translation exists we fill the gap with machine translation, and label it as such so you know the source. If you spot an error, send it under "Translation error".
contact.a2: We cover only the 15 designated population-declining areas of Gyeongsangbuk-do. Large cities and well-known destinations are out of scope.
contact.a3: Narrow conditions can leave nothing to build from. Raising the travel intensity or picking fewer interests widens the pool.
contact.a4: Tourism data is collected once a day. Time-bound details such as festival dates may differ on the ground, so check before you travel.

privacyDoc.title: Privacy Policy
summary: There is no sign-up, so we do not ask for personal details such as your name or contact information.
We do not collect your device location. Coordinates shown on the map are the locations of tourist sites.
We do not use cookies. Only your theme and language choices are stored in your browser and can be cleared from browser settings.
To display maps, a Kakao script runs directly in your browser.

b: The Service has no registration process and does not ask users to enter personal data such as names or contact details.

Enquiries are sent directly from your own mail client (mailto); the Service neither relays nor stores their contents. Information contained in an email you send does remain in the operator's mailbox for the purpose of replying.

Access records such as IP address, access time and browser type may be generated automatically by the server during use. 【To confirm: whether access logs are retained in the deployment environment, and for how long】
Automatically generated access records are used only to operate the Service, diagnose faults and prevent abuse.
Information contained in enquiry emails is used only to answer that enquiry.
Access records are destroyed without delay once their purpose is fulfilled. 【To confirm: the specific retention period】
Enquiry emails are deleted once there is no further need to retain them after a reply.
Where applicable law prescribes a separate retention period, that period applies.
The operator does not provide users' personal data to third parties.
Where a request is made on a legal basis, the operator complies with it.
External hosting is used to operate the Service. 【To confirm: hosting provider and the scope of the outsourced work】

To display maps, the Kakao Maps script runs in your browser, and your browser communicates directly with Kakao's servers. Kakao's own privacy policy applies to information processed by Kakao in that exchange.
The sharing feature operates only when you press the share button, at which point Kakao's sharing script runs.
Directions buttons are links to external map services; the policies of those services apply once you leave.
The Service does not collect location (GPS) data from your device.
Coordinates shown on the map are the locations of tourist sites, not your location.
The Service does not use cookies.
Two values are stored in your browser's local storage to keep your display settings: (1) colour theme (light/dark), (2) display language.
Neither identifies an individual, and both are removed when you clear site data in your browser settings.
Because the Service does not collect or hold personal data directly from users, there is in principle no information subject to access, correction or deletion.
If you nonetheless need something checked, you may contact us at the address below, and we will handle it as prescribed by applicable law.
【To confirm: name or role of the data protection officer, and a contactable email address】
Please direct enquiries about the handling of personal data to the contact above.
Where this policy changes, the effective date and the nature of the change are posted within the Service, and previous versions are kept available to read.
